content.text: poss need higher dose (18-24 mg); confirm no caffeine recently
↓initial dose to 3 mg to prevent prolonged asystole
Amiodarone inhibits CYP2C9 - INR rises significantly
Denervated heart has no vagal innervation - atropine ineffective
Use transcutaneous pacing or dopamine/epinephrine infusion
Loss of patellar reflex - resp arrest - cardiac arrest
Antidote: calcium gluconate 1 g IV; monitor reflexes during eclampsia Mg infusion
Unopposed alpha stim worsens coronary spasm & hypertension
Use benzodiazepines as first-line; if vasodilation needed: phentolamine; avoid non-selective beta-blockers
CNS (tinnitus - drowsiness - szs) before cardiac toxicity
tx szs w benzodiazepines; ↓or stop infusion
WORSENS TdP by further prolonging QT interval
Use magnesium sulfate 2 g IV; correct electrolytes; discontinue QT-prolonging drugs
NOT routinely recommended - poss worsen intracellular acidosis & CO2 elevation
Use only for specific indications: hyperkalemia, severe acidosis pH <7.1, TCA/Na-channel blocker toxicity
